title: 第1章 师兄的请求第2章 你也不想
slug: 听我解释真不是你们想的那样
content_zh:
??脑子寄存处～）
黑屋常客，观看先加书架～
“师弟，求你了，今晚我洞房花烛，你替我去呗！”
玄天宗，陆沉的洞府里，一身婚服的男主林天如是说道。
陆沉：“？？！”
“师兄，你要不要听听你在说什么？你和嫂子的大婚之日，让我过去干嘛？”
“唉，还不是魅姬闹的厉害，说我若是成亲，她就不活了，现在她独自前往禁地去了……”
陆沉闻言，眼神微凛。
没错，他穿书了，一本玄幻多女主小说里。
而面前这个穿婚服的，就是小说里的男主林天，他是一个从头到尾都很正义，善良的主角，对待亲友更是两肋插刀。
所以陆沉穿越过来后，一直和他打好关系，成为了好兄弟，两人都互相付出了真感情。
今天林天成亲，他打心底里为好兄弟高兴。
可他万万没有想到，剧情因为自己出现了偏差，林天让自己替他成亲！
“行了，别说荒唐话了。”陆沉一脸严肃的拒绝。
“师弟，我的意思是让你去拖延一夜，我拦住魅姬之后，马上就回来！”
“听我说师兄，魅姬和你现在都只是情绪上头，很快你们就会冷静下来。
而我若是真听了你的话，和嫂子一起入洞房，即便我们之间什么也没有做，那也是黄泥巴掉裤裆！
届时，即便你我之间感情再好，未来也会有一道缝隙存在！不要再提了！”
陆沉拒绝的彻底。
因为他知道故事的剧情，这对林天来说只是前期的小修罗场，嫂子也是性情中人，林天很快就能解决问题。

“我知道师弟你的顾虑，但我绝对不是那样的人……”
林天话还没说完，陆沉便已经转过了身子。
“休要再提此事！”
林天闻言，咬了咬牙。
“时间不多了师弟，对不住了！”
只见林天忽然暴起，对着陆沉额头一点，后者眼前一黑，便晕了过去……
……
等到陆沉悠悠转醒的时候，他已经出现在了林天的洞府里，身上穿的也是林天的婚服。
“夫君，夫君？怎么还在门外，是喝多了吗？”屋内传来关切的声音。
正是林天的妻子，陆沉的嫂子，庄静白。
同样，她也是小说的女主之一。
“夫君，进来呀～妾身已经……”
陆沉站在洞房门外，额头冷汗直冒。
“夫君？”
陆沉咬了咬牙，硬着头皮推门而入。
红烛高照，洞房里一片喜庆的红色。庄静白端坐在床边，一身凤冠霞帔，头上盖着大红盖头，看不见面容。
陆沉见状，心里稍微松了一口气。

"Junior brother, please, please go to my bridal chamber tonight for me!"
Xuantian Sect, in Lu Chen's cave, the male protagonist Lin Tianru said in wedding clothes.
Lu Chen: "??!"
"Senior brother, do you want to listen to what you are saying? Why do you want me to come over on your wedding day to your sister-in-law?"
"Oh, Mei Ji made such a big fuss, saying that if I got married, she would die. Now she goes to the forbidden place alone..."
When Lu Chen heard this, his eyes were slightly stern.
That's right, he's in a book, a fantasy novel with multiple female protagonists.
The man in wedding clothes in front of him is the male protagonist Lin Tian in the novel. He is a righteous and kind protagonist from beginning to end, and he treats his relatives and friends even more.
So after Lu Chen traveled through time, he always had a good relationship with him and became good brothers. Both of them had true feelings for each other.
Lin Tian got married today, and he was happy for his good brother from the bottom of his heart.
But he never expected that the plot would go awry because of him, and Lin Tian would ask him to get married for him!
"Okay, stop saying ridiculous things." Lu Chen refused with a serious look.
"Junior brother, I want you to delay it all night. I will come back immediately after I stop Mei Ji!"
"Listen to me, senior brother, Mei Ji and you are just in a state of emotion right now, and you will calm down soon.
And if I really listened to you and entered the bridal chamber with my sister-in-law, even if we didn't do anything, it would be nothing but mud!
By then, no matter how good the relationship between you and me is, there will still be a gap in the future! Don't mention it again! "
Lu Chen refused completely.
Because he knows the plot of the story, this is just a small Shura field in the early stage for Lin Tian. His sister-in-law is also a sweetheart, and Lin Tian can solve the problem quickly.
"I understand your concerns, junior brother, but I am definitely not that kind of person..."
Before Lin Tian finished speaking, Lu Chen had already turned around.
"Don't mention this again!"
Lin Tian gritted his teeth when he heard this.
"Time is running out, junior brother, I'm sorry!"
Lin Tian suddenly raised his head and touched Lu Shen's forehead. The latter's eyes darkened and he fainted...
…
When Lu Chen Youyou woke up, he had already appeared in Lin Tian's cave, wearing Lin Tian's wedding clothes.
"Husband, husband? Why are you still outside the door? Are you drunk?" A concerned voice came from inside the house.
It was Lin Tian's wife and Lu Chen's sister-in-law, Zhuang Jingbai.
Likewise, she is also one of the heroines of the novel.
"Husband, come in~ I am already..."
Lu Chen stood outside the bridal chamber door, sweat breaking out on his forehead.
"Husband?"
Lu Chen gritted his teeth and pushed the door open.
The red candles were shining brightly, and the bridal chamber was a festive red. Zhuang Jingbai was sitting beside the bed, dressed in a phoenix crown and a haori, with a red hijab covering her head, her face invisible.
Lu Chen felt a little relieved when he saw this.
